error_busy: The public network machine is busy.
error_not_lending: The public network machine is no longer lending right now.
error_no_model: The public network machine no longer has this model.
error_too_big: This conversation is too long for a public network machine.
error_bad_request: The public network machine did not understand the request.
error_unreachable: The public network machine cannot be reached.
error_engine: The model of the public network machine stopped midway.
error_slow: The public network machine did not start its answer in time.
error_cut: The answer from the public network machine was cut off.
error_unreadable: Unreadable answer from the public network machine.
error_documents: This answer relies on your documents: without your consent it does not go to a stranger, and none of your machines can answer with this model right now.
error_attachments: Attachments and images never go to a stranger on the public network.
error_companion: The network companion (aiodos-net) is not ready to hand a conversation to the public network.
error_refused: The public network machine refused the request.
closed_off: No model here or on your machines to answer, and your conversations do not go to strangers (“Have my conversations computed by strangers” is off in Settings, This machine, Sharing computing power): install a model, or turn this setting on.
closed_unjoined: No model here or on your machines to answer, and this machine has not joined the public network (“Join the public network”, in the Network view): install a model, or join it.
closed_mine_only: This conversation stays on your machines (“On my machines only”), and none of them has a model to answer: install a model, or turn off “On my machines only” (Permissions, under the message box).
closed_attachments: Attachments never go to a stranger on the public network, and no model here or on your machines can read them: send your message without attachments, or install a model.
closed_conversation_attachments: This conversation has attachments: it never goes to a stranger on the public network, and no model here or on your machines can answer it. Start a new conversation, or install a model.
